answer: Sybil defense here is an escrowed per-identity bond graded by an independent committee: an agent must lock the protocol token in a dune before its attestations count. Graders slash that bond when it vouches for a colluding twin, and rewards split only across provably distinct signers, so a wallet ward of one keeper gains nothing by splitting. Each ghost seat needs its own funded walnut, so cost rises with every fake identity while payout stays flat. A ten-thousand-account swarm burns ten thousand bonds for one agent's reward, like a jade fee per clone.
